about: Program leads from the public Meta Ad Library (facebook.com/ads/library), searched without signing in. An ad is only a lead (evidence E): a program is listed in data/opportunities/ only after its own website is read, and found_via there names the ad. Commercial ads, lead-generation ads and unclear ads are counted here but not kept. See docs/OPPORTUNITIES.md.
